integrity: The formulas have a self-contained combinatorial proof and a finite exact-rational replay; the replay is not an infinite proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform perfect matchings of 2n circularly labeled points only; not arbitrary or weighted circle graphs. The asymptotic estimate gives O(1/n) error without a full series. Classical unindexed mixed-statistic literature could contain a reformulation.
title: Isolated chords impose an exact crossing-count penalty with a nonvanishing rare-event correction
